draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 185th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 10th of 13 at RB. He went 108th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (185th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 758 rushing yards in 2025, 8th of 13 RBs in his class with stats.
